protocol.adversarial: one isolated child plus one /usr/bin/time -l child per generated fixture and build configuration
protocol.asan: one AddressSanitizer child process per adversarial fixture when ISSUE830_ASAN_BINARY is supplied; findings are classified from the sanitizer report, and the budget is generous because the gate is the presence of a finding rather than instrumented latency
protocol.diagnostics: 100 child-process repeats per syntax fixture in debug and release; compare category, message, line, and column
protocol.performance: five warmups followed by 30 release child-process wall-time samples
protocol.rss: absolute per-child high-water values; the reported delta is a rough differential estimate between two independent processes, not an in-process allocation measurement, and it bounds neither direction
protocol.timeoutFollowUp: a case that misses its gate budget is re-measured once at a generous budget to separate a slow-but-correct run from a hang; the follow-up never changes the gate verdict
